greeting: Hi there, I'm Sofia Alvarez Rodero
description: I’m a Junior Front-end Developer with less than a year of professional experience, but over four years of continuous learning and building personal projects to grow and break into the tech industry. I hold a Technical Degree in Programming, earned in September 2024 from the National Technological University of Argentina. My main passion is React, though I also enjoy crafting interfaces with WordPress or building APIs in Java. I'm currently studying UX/UI design to give more meaning to the platforms I create and to continually improve my performance. My goal is to grow professionally, learn through hands-on experience, and most of all, spend my time doing what I love. I consider myself responsible, proactive, organized, and detail-oriented. I strive to give my best in every project, strengthening my skills with each step I take. I hope we can work together on a project soon! I’ll be truly grateful to anyone who gives me an opportunity to move forward on this path.
